name: Rectangular Flowerpot with Four Small Feet
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably 15th century；Numbered Jun ware: light gray stoneware with variegated purple and blue glaze; with Chinese numeral 10 (shi) inscribed on base before firing;  "Yangxin dian Dongnuan ge louxia yong" (Hall of Mental Cultivation, used in the East Heated Chamber, main floor) inscription incised on base at a later date
